tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Search for products using natural language descriptions. Uses AI embeddings for semantic understanding — handles vague requests like "comfortable shoes for standing all day" or "gift for a 10 year old who likes science". Falls back to keyword search when vector data is unavailable.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full details for a specific product by its provider and ID. Use after search results to get more info before recommending.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2-5 products side by side. Returns a structured comparison of price, rating, shipping, and key features. Use when the user is deciding between options.

tools.name: find_lowest_price
tools.description: Find the single lowest-priced product matching the stated constraints. Ranks on price, adjusted for the priorities the caller states (rating, shipping) — never on WEM commission. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, semantic_search, get_categories, get_product, compare_products, find_lowest_price, compare_offers, verify_offer, lookup_products, get_evidence_receipt, search_promotions · Public sink: lookup_products, search_promotions · Destructive: search_products, semantic_search, get_product, compare_products, find_lowest_price, compare_offers, verify_offer, lookup_products, search_promotions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, semantic_search, get_categories, get_product, compare_products, find_lowest_price, compare_offers, verify_offer, lookup_products, get_evidence_receipt, search_promotions · Public sink: lookup_products, search_promotions · Destructive: search_products, semantic_search, get_product, compare_products, find_lowest_price, compare_offers, verify_offer, lookup_products, search_promotions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
